featuredImage.alt: How MarketJoy Helped Tele-Vac Break into Municipal Markets in Six Months

html:
“With MarketJoy’s strategic outreach and algorithm-driven targeting, we connected with key municipal contacts faster than ever before.” 

Tele-Vac Environmental provides high-performance vacuum excavation and utility locating services tailored to municipal and commercial clients. Their focus is on safe, efficient, and environmentally conscious infrastructure maintenance and development solutions. 

“As the Sales and Business Development Director at Tele-Vac Environmental, I faced significant challenges in reaching the right municipal contacts. We needed a solution that could target specific decision-makers quickly and efficiently, and MarketJoy delivered beyond our expectations. MarketJoy’s team understood our unique needs and swiftly identified key contacts within municipalities, whether they were engineers or sewer collections foremen. Their innovative algorithms and targeted strategies enabled us to connect with decision-makers much faster than our internal team could manage. They not only handled the time-consuming tasks of prospecting and initial outreach, freeing up our time for other critical tasks, but also delivered valuable leads and market research. This support was crucial for our strategic decisions, particularly in Alabama, where their efforts were instrumental in gathering market insights and driving our outreach strategy forward. MarketJoy’s commitment to our success and their ability to adapt to our challenging requirements has been outstanding. They have become an indispensable partner in our growth, and I highly recommend their services to any company facing similar outreach challenges.” 

— Mike Moore, Sales and Business Development Director, Tele-Vac Environmental 

Municipal decision-makers are notoriously difficult to reach, often spread across departments and protected by layers of administrative gatekeeping. Tele-Vac Environmental was investing significant internal resources to identify the right contacts in cities and towns, yet results were slow and inconsistent. With critical market goals in mind, particularly in Alabama, they needed a partner who could efficiently identify and connect them with qualified leads in the public sector. 

Tele-Vac aimed to build a reliable pipeline of municipal decision-makers in target regions to grow their public sector contracts. They lacked the time and tools to segment their market and contact lists effectively, slowing their business development cycle. They needed more than generic leads they needed verified decision-makers, segmented by geography and job role, to accelerate conversations and close deals. 

MarketJoy immediately tailored its outreach engine to Tele-Vac’s municipal targeting requirements. Using a combination of proprietary algorithms, industry research, and human-led verification, MarketJoy segmented potential contacts across municipal roles including engineers, public works heads, and sewer collections foremen. Email outreach was supported with insightful messaging tailored to each role, and MarketJoy took full ownership of the time-consuming research and outbound efforts. Campaigns were continuously optimized based on response data and market shifts. 

  • Connected Tele-Vac with key municipal decision-makers across Alabama and other target regions within 4-6 months.
  • Delivered strategic market research that influenced regional outreach plans.
  • Took ownership of prospecting and outreach, enabling Tele-Vac to reallocate internal bandwidth to higher-value sales conversations.
  • Generated over 50 high-quality commercial and municipal leads 

Struggling to connect with the right municipal or commercial decision-makers? MarketJoy helps organizations like Tele-Vac break through bureaucratic layers and get in front of the right people faster.

In under six months, we helped build a targeted outreach engine that delivered qualified leads, market insights, and time savings.
